name: ses-lockdown
description: Tether Secure Browser v1.7.1 (destroyed-window crash fix: restoreLockdownControls/reportAuditFactBestEffort could throw 'Object has been destroyed' when the BrowserWindow's closed event fired, crashing the main process — restoration is now independent of any window and audit reporting is routed through a shared isWindowUsable/runOnWindowBestEffort guard. Built on v1.7.0's Tether Windows Lockdown Hardening v1 — adds a Windows-only process-detection service for known remote-control/debugging/virtualization/screen-capture applications, a remote-session/VM indicator, a main-owned preflight gate and during-exam blocking overlay, an idempotent restoration lifecycle, and materially strengthened Electron hardening: a permission allowlist, denied navigation/window.open/downloads, packaged-build DevTools prevention, rejected unsafe command-line switches, and blocked browser-chrome keyboard shortcuts. See docs/tether-windows-lockdown-hardening-v1.md. v1.4.0 and v1.5.0 were development-only, never distributed.)

scripts.pack: npm run build && electron-builder --dir && npm run verify:package
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win && npm run verify:package -- release/win-unpacked
